prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in Miami FL for a home purchase loan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” lender in Miami—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, and whether you qualify for assistance. **My practical recommendation is to get written Loan Estimates from at least three lenders and compare the same loan terms**, rather than choosing by a ranking or advertised rate.

If you’re a first-time buyer, start with a **Florida Housing-approved lender** and ask whether you qualify for state down-payment assistance. If the home is within the City of Miami, check the City’s participating-lender list too; Miami-Dade County has separate assistance programs. These programs have eligibility rules and may require using an approved lender.

When comparing offers, look at the **interest rate, APR, lender fees, points, cash to close, rate-lock period, and ability to meet your closing date**. Ask each lender for a Loan Estimate for the same purchase price, down payment, and loan type.

Official starting points:
- [Florida Housing homebuyer programs](https://www.floridahousing.org/programs/homebuyer-overview-page)
- [City of Miami participating lenders](https://www.miami.gov/Housing-Assistance/Home-Ownership/Apply-for-First-Time-Homebuyer-Assistance/First-Time-Homebuyer-Program-Participating-Banks)
- [Miami-Dade County homeownership programs](https://www.miamidade.gov/global/housing/homeownership.page)

If you share your approximate price range, down payment, credit-score range, and whether you’re a first-time buyer, I can help narrow down what lender and loan options to compare.
